chunks: Yunus, from Aban ibn 'Uthman, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام: concerning
A man who struck another man wrongfully, and the man repelled him from himself, and something happened to him—he said: “There is nothing against him.”

key_terms.فَأَصَابَهُ: then something afflicted him, meaning some injury or harm reached the aggressor
key_terms.فَرَدَّهُ: he repelled him, meaning he pushed back or defended against the attack
key_terms.لَا شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ: nothing is upon him, meaning no liability or penalty is due

ai.seo_question: Is a person liable if he injures an aggressor while defending himself from wrongful assault?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a person who is wrongfully attacked and defends himself. If the aggressor is injured as a result of that self-defense, no liability is upon the one who defended himself.
